About Me

I'm a GenAI Engineer and Solution Architect with 11+ years of experience building scalable enterprise platforms. For the last two years, I've been fully focused on production-grade Agentic AI — not just prototypes, but systems that run in production and measurably impact teams.

At BOLD, I architected an AI Performance Investigation Assistant that autonomously triages 500+ incidents weekly — reducing engineering analysis time by 60%. Real impact. Real production. Real data.

I've built end-to-end Agentic AI PoCs using LangGraph, ChromaDB, Groq, FastAPI and connected them to Microsoft Copilot Studio as plugin actions deployed to Power Platform. I understand both the code layer and the enterprise deployment layer.

I believe the best AI architects aren't just engineers — they're translators between technical possibility and business value. That's what I do.
